subject: IMP status: base repros green, AGD schedule sensitivity is the risk
body:
Anders, Bruno,

Status. Both base repros are green: IMP-B lands 80.4 IN1k / 63.5 K400 (released: 80.5 / 63.6 - within noise), and IMP-MoE-B matches on the video suite including the 88.7 UCF101 headline. Audio (ESC50) reproduces as well. Retrieval probes off the shared embedding space look promising - cross-modal recall@10 beats our current two-tower baseline by 9% on the internal video-text set.

The risk for the MoE-L run: the alternating gradient descent schedule is sensitive at scale. In our B-scale ablations, reordering the modality alternation changed final IN1k by up to 0.8 pts, and we haven't validated the released schedule at L scale. If the first two days of the Vulcan week show instability, we fall back to Csilla's reduced-token-budget variant with the conservative schedule rather than burning the week debugging.

Vera has the eval configs (sparse_moe_imp_base.all.eval and friends) staged so results flow the moment training checkpoints land.

Csilla
